rdfs:label: accelerationUnits
dc:description: Units of acceleration, for example the acceleration of a limb or head measured by an accelerometer.

rdfs:label: angleUnits
dc:description: Units of plane angle, for example visual angle or joint rotation.

rdfs:label: areaUnits
dc:description: Units of area, for example the size of a stimulus region or a surface on a display.

rdfs:label: chargeUnits
dc:description: Units of electric charge, for example the charge per phase delivered by electrical stimulation.

rdfs:label: concentrationUnits
dc:description: Units of molar concentration (amount of substance per unit volume).

rdfs:label: currencyUnits
dc:description: Units indicating the worth of something.

rdfs:label: currentUnits
dc:description: Units of electric current, for example the current delivered by electrical stimulation.

rdfs:label: electricPotentialUnits
dc:description: Units of electric potential, for example EEG and other electrophysiological signal amplitudes.

rdfs:label: energyUnits
dc:description: Units of energy, for example the energy of a stimulation pulse or metabolic energy.

rdfs:label: forceUnits
dc:description: Units of force, for example grip force or the reading of a force plate.

rdfs:label: frequencyUnits
dc:description: Units of frequency, for example sampling rates, flicker rates, and tone frequencies.

rdfs:label: intensityUnits
dc:description: Units of intensity expressed as a ratio to a reference level, for example sound pressure level in dB, together with candela for luminous intensity.

rdfs:label: jerkUnits
dc:description: Units of jerk, the rate of change of acceleration, for example in measures of movement smoothness.

rdfs:label: magneticFieldUnits
dc:description: Units of magnetic flux density, for example MEG signal amplitudes and MRI field strength.

rdfs:label: memorySizeUnits
dc:description: Units of digital storage size, for example the size of a data file. Byte is treated as an SI unit for prefix purposes although it is not part of the SI.

rdfs:label: physicalLengthUnits
dc:description: Units of length, for example distances, positions, and sizes of objects or stimuli.

rdfs:label: powerUnits
dc:description: Units of power, for example the output of an optogenetic light source or ultrasound transducer.

rdfs:label: pressureUnits
dc:description: Units of pressure, for example blood pressure or the pressure of a tactile or pneumatic stimulus.

rdfs:label: resistanceUnits
dc:description: Units of electrical resistance or impedance, for example electrode impedance.

rdfs:label: speedUnits
dc:description: Units of speed, for example the speed of a moving stimulus or of a participant.

rdfs:label: temperatureUnits
dc:description: Units of temperature, for example ambient or skin temperature.

rdfs:label: timeUnits
dc:description: Units of time, for example durations, delays, and intervals between events.

rdfs:label: volumeUnits
dc:description: Units of volume, for example the amount of liquid reward delivered or the volume of an infusion.

rdfs:label: weightUnits
dc:description: Units of mass, for example body weight or the mass of a delivered substance.
